### Line 1: N-54 (4) (CONFIRMED)

**The code.** In `receipts.ts`, `waterGateReceipt(k, p, water, commit, slice, s5)` builds one record per enceinte:
the commit's enceinte, then S5's `enceintes`, then any enceinte named only by a `wall` row in the arena, which is
marked `recorded: false`. Each water gate attaches to the enceinte its `Gate.enceinte` names. The gate list is the
commit's `waterGates` plus S5's `gates` of kind `water`, de-duplicated by id. A wet wall edge belongs to every enceinte
its `wall` rows name. It reads gated only when it carries exactly one `wall_gate` row of that enceinte's own water gates
and joins that gate's two resolved ends (lines 558–581). `runRecord` passes `s5Walls(d)`, the model's `enceintes` and
`gates` keys. These are S5's output when S5 ended ok, and S3's otherwise (`pipeline/base.ts:481`, `:590-593`). In
`report.ts`, `foldGroup` fails a derivation when any enceinte row breaks the bar or N has changed, so matching totals
cannot hide a bad row.

**The CITY re-run** used relief-60 at CITY with both configurations, from mirror `s1/`. The command was
`PLAT_BENCH_OUT=../out-<s> corepack pnpm bench -- site --first <s> --seeds 1 --fixture relief-60 --config both --workers 2`.

| 9 | default | S1–S6 ok | enceinte:1 (stage 1) 0/0/0/0/0/0/0; enceinte:2 (stage 2) **4/4/3/3/8/8/0** | **fail** (failing [9]; `laterGates` 4, `unrecordedWallOverWater` 0) | unobserved (no bridge built) |
| 9 | coarse | S5 refused E_SELF_INTERSECT | enceinte:1 0/0/0/0/0/0/0 | unobserved | pass |
| 1 | default | S5 refused E_SELF_INTERSECT | enceinte:1 2/2/2/2/4/4/0 | pass | pass (3 built, 3 with a span, 0 way edges over water off a span) |
| 1 | coarse | S5 refused E_SELF_INTERSECT | enceinte:1 2/2/2/2/4/4/0 | pass | pass (3 built) |

These figures match C-0291 (4) on every count. Seeds 1 and 15 read 0 ungated wet edges. C-0271 (11) recorded 3
clipping edges on seed 1; those are gone after M0-c-02 s1. On seed 9 the old receipt reported all of stage 2's wet
edges as ungated. They now read as enceinte:2's, with 3 of 4 gated.

**Seed 9's remaining wet edge** was checked with an independent probe. `zz-check-probe.test.ts` reads the river rings
through the façade's level-0 view, each wall edge's rows and each gate's resolved `banks`
(`s1/probe-out-9-default.txt`). `gate:w0`'s gated line is two edges:

* 6079 (−13928, −90189) → 1977 (−13908, −90171): 27 cm, not wet, rows `wall`, `wall_gate:gate:w0`, `shore`, `bank`.
* 1977 → 6080 (−9391, −88784): 47.25 m, wet (mid-depth 993 cm), rows `wall:enceinte:2`, `wall_gate:gate:w0`.

The gate's pins are 6079 and 6080. The wet side therefore starts 27 cm away from a pin, so it is no chord between the
two bank pins. The other three gates (w1–w3) are exact chords. The ruling seat's pre-fix replay shows the same edge
(`ruling-geom/q5-relief-60-9.json` `wetWall[0]`, `aRows: []`); it was read, not run. M0-c-02 s1 removed the two bare
chords and left this one. Under the required change, "any non-zero is a cross-item line for M0-c-02, not a KI", so it
is routed as note 14 and is not a line against M0-e-06. **The session should add a fix-queue row for M0-c-02.**

All three kill-tests the brief names are held: the stage-1-only read (M1, M1b, M9), the dropped span test (M2, M2b)
and stage-k gates attributed to stage 1 (M3). There were no survivors.

**The pins** (`bench/test/site/spike.test.ts`, describe "every enceinte's wall over water is read against its own
water gates"):

* On relief-60 CITY seed 9, enceinte:2's row equals an independent per-gate reading through the façade.
* The stage-1-only reading puts enceinte:2 at `recorded: false` with 0 gated edges, and the fold fails it.
* Three cases still read ungated and fail the fold: a chord whose gate S5 does not hold, gates moved to enceinte:1, and
  reversed banks.

`fold.test.ts` adds cases where a stage-2 wet edge, a stage-2 strip vertex, an unrecorded wall and the masked totals
each fail. **The summary** (`summaries/M0-e-06.json`, sha `e171d4dc…` as recorded) is the 32-derivation CITY run. Its
waterGates numbers carry `enceintes`, `laterGates` and `unrecordedWallOverWater`. relief-60 passes on both
configurations (2 gates, 2 wet edges, 2 gated) and relief-3000 is unobserved. **C-0291** refines C-0271 (6) and (11)
and names the tests above.
